name: xxd-panel-187
title_zh: 档案拼贴加大字，做出 187 号面板那张海报
tagline_zh: 手里有旧照片、剪报、票据却排不出味道？它把素材按档案拼贴逻辑分层压进画面，再让一行大字横穿压住所有碎片。
tagline_en: Got old photos, clippings and receipts but no layout? It layers them as archival collage, then drives one.
desc_en: Create Panel 187 raster artwork: Archival Collage with Oversized Type. Use when the user invokes xxd-panel-187 or requests this specific visual language.
why_zh: 拼贴层和文字层分开生成再合成，大字是压上去的，不是叠上去的，所以层级关系站得住。
why_en: Collage layers and type layer are generated separately then composited, so the oversized line presses onto the image instead of.
limit_zh: 只出 187 号这一种视觉语言，换风格它不接；需要你自备素材图，它不生成照片内容；成图是位图海报。
limit_en: Only the Panel 187 visual language — no other styles. You must supply source images; it won't generate photo content. Output is a flat raster.
title_en: Panel 187: Archival Collage Poster with Oversized Type
